sentences.english: After they had been allowed to see the original record, their doubts in fact grew lighter.

sentences.chinese: 要是期限没有被悄悄提前，准备时间本来是够的。
sentences.english: If the date had not been quietly brought forward, there would have been time enough to prepare.

sentences.chinese: 尽管外界称之为突破，作者仍只把它看作初步发现。
sentences.english: Widely hailed as a breakthrough, the finding was still called by its author no more than a first result.

sentences.chinese: 我很少见到摘要里也写下没有做到的事情。
sentences.english: Seldom have I seen a summary that also states what was not done.

sentences.chinese: 没有比例尺，这张图只能告诉你形状，不能告诉你距离。
sentences.english: Without a scale, this map can show you shape but not distance.

sentences.chinese: 他把责任分得越散，听众就越想知道究竟是谁做的决定。
sentences.english: The more widely he shared out the blame, the more the listeners wanted to know who had actually decided.

sentences.chinese: 直到回声消失，指挥才把手放下。
sentences.english: Not until the echo had faded did the conductor lower his hand.

sentences.chinese: 如果分类标准前后一致，这些条目就不会分进两个章节。
sentences.english: Had the rule of grouping stayed the same, these items would not have fallen into two chapters.

sentences.chinese: 把灯光调暗之后，屏幕上的细线才看得见。
sentences.english: With the lamps turned low, the thin lines on the screen became visible.

sentences.chinese: 要不是页脚里那行几乎看不见的字，两个版本的差别就不会被发现。
sentences.english: But for the nearly invisible line in the footer, the difference between the two versions would not have been noticed.

sentences.chinese: 她刚指出这段省略，整段论证的力量就弱了下去。
sentences.english: No sooner had she pointed out what had been left out than the force of the argument fell away.

sentences.chinese: 无论包装多么完整，没有来源的判断仍然只是判断。
sentences.english: However finished the presentation, a judgment with no source behind it is still only a judgment.

sentences.chinese: 我倒希望你把不能确定的地方留给读者，而不是替他们做决定。
sentences.english: I would rather you had left the uncertain places to the reader instead of deciding them for the reader.

sentences.chinese: 尽管修好的表面很光滑，旧裂痕在斜光下仍然显现。
sentences.english: Smooth as the mended surface is, the old crack still appears when the light falls across it.

sentences.chinese: 如果当时有人要求看原始底片，后来的争议就不会这么大。
sentences.english: If someone had asked to see the original plate, the dispute that followed would not have grown so large.

sentences.chinese: 直到把口头承诺写成条款，双方才发现彼此理解的不是同一件事。
sentences.english: Not until the spoken promise had been written as clauses did the two sides find that they had not meant the same thing.

sentences.chinese: 真正让项目延期的不是技术，而是没有人肯为最后的选择负责。
sentences.english: What held the work up was not the technique, but the fact that no one would answer for the final choice.

sentences.chinese: 任何经不起换一种说法的结论，都不该被写成确定无疑的话。
sentences.english: No conclusion that falls apart when restated should be written as though it were certain.

sentences.chinese: 你把条件说得越具体，别人就越难用空话把你挡回去。
sentences.english: The more exactly you state the conditions, the harder it is for others to put you off with empty words.

sentences.chinese: 倘若水位在黎明前再涨一尺，低处的路就会被切断。
sentences.english: Should the water rise another foot before dawn, the lower road will be cut off.

sentences.chinese: 放在全文末尾，这句道歉看起来更像补救，而不像承认。
sentences.english: Placed at the very end, the apology looks more like a patch than an admission.

sentences.chinese: 要是早期的反对被记录下来，后来的人就不会以为当时无人质疑。
sentences.english: Had the early objections been written down, later readers would not have supposed that no one questioned it then.

sentences.chinese: 尽管数据已经足够画出一条线，作者仍然拒绝称之为规律。
sentences.english: Sufficient as the figures were to draw a line, the author still refused to call that line a law.

sentences.chinese: 我很少看到有人在争论占了上风之后，还愿意指出自己论证中的薄弱处。
sentences.english: Seldom do I see a person who, having got the better of an argument, will still point out the weak place in his own case.

sentences.chinese: 没有那份按日期排列的附录，这些回忆就只能停留在印象。
sentences.english: Without the appendix set out by date, these memories would remain mere impressions.

sentences.chinese: 场面越安静，任何一个细小的声音就越显得突兀。
sentences.english: The quieter the scene grew, the more sudden every small sound seemed.

sentences.chinese: 直到最后一个证人离开，法官才把笔放下。
sentences.english: Not until the last witness had gone did the judge lay down his pen.

sentences.chinese: 如果这个界限从一开始就被遵守，后面的解释就不必越写越长。
sentences.english: Had this limit been kept from the first, the later explanations would not have had to grow longer and longer.

sentences.chinese: 把所有修饰都去掉之后，这句话真正说的只是：证据还不够。
sentences.english: All the ornament taken away, what the sentence really says is simply that the evidence is not yet enough.
